title: Run event — one line of state/run-events.jsonl
description: The unified, append-only L0 event stream for a run. One JSON object per line. The WRAPPER fields (ts/run_id/event + the run-context paper/round/milestone/stage) are filled by bin/log_event.sh from state/pipeline-state.json (or AR_* env overrides); event-specific fields are merged at the top level from the caller's payload. This stream is a PURE SIDE-CHANNEL: nothing in spec/research.js's control flow ever reads it back to make a decision. The correlation key that joins an event to the native per-agent transcript is `agent_id` (= subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl filename = jsonl `agentId` field). Schema is intentionally permissive (additionalProperties:true) — it pins the wrapper + the known event vocabulary, not every payload shape.

ts.description: UTC ISO8601, e.g. 2026-06-13T21:18:05Z (single clock source: time.gmtime)

run_id.description: L0-generated run id (date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ + spec short-sha); persisted in pipeline-state.json; SAME across resume/re-wake and across MULTIPLE sessions of one logical run

agent_id.description: on agent_return/agent_spawn: the spawned L1's agentId — JOIN KEY to ~/.claude/projects/<proj>/<session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl
